cards.title: IUPAC Gold Book — hybridization
supports: Hybridization is a linear combination of atomic orbitals and is used as an orbital-model description.
does_not_support: A claim that an sp/sp2/sp3 label is a unique observable partition of a molecular wavefunction.
A claim that the label alone causes geometry or reactivity.

cards.title: IUPAC Gold Book — hybrid orbital
supports: A hybrid orbital is an atomic orbital derived through hybridization of orbitals of different angular momentum on the same atom.
does_not_support: Exact percentages of s/p character in the benchmark cases unless a defined calculation is supplied.

cards.title: Role of Conjugation in the Stabilities and Rotational Barriers of Formamide and Thioformamide. An ab Initio Valence-Bond Study
supports: Delocalization/conjugation is significant in planar formamide.
The formamide C-N rotational barrier is not solely due to conjugation; other structural/electronic preferences contribute.
does_not_support: Treating a qualitative p-overlap sketch as a direct measurement of donation strength.
Deriving a total-energy cos(theta) law from a qualitative overlap factor.

cards.title: Resonance in formamide: resolution of contending models
supports: Planar formamide exhibits an important pi-space N-to-carbonyl interaction in a valence-bond description.
Rotated formamide is electronically different and the interaction becomes much less stabilizing in that model.
does_not_support: A claim that one orbital partition is the only possible physical description.
A claim that changing the hybridisation label is itself the physical cause of lost donation.

cards.title: Rotation about the C—N bond in formamide: an ab initio molecular orbital study of structure and energetics in the gas phase and in solution
supports: Formamide C-N rotation is a genuine structural/energetic problem studied with explicit electronic-structure models.
does_not_support: Promoting the benchmark's deliberately simplified cos(theta) overlap model into a complete total-energy law.

cards.title: Vacuum ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy of transient species. Part 7.—The methyl radical
supports: Photoelectron evidence led the authors to conclude that methyl radical is essentially planar in its ground electronic state.
does_not_support: A universal claim that any three-sigma-bond centre has an empty p orbital.

cards.title: Electron affinity of the methyl radical: Structures of CH3 and CH3-
supports: The study reports planar D3h methyl radical and contrasts it with pyramidal CH3-.
does_not_support: Treating a simplified hybridisation assignment as a uniquely measured property.

cards.title: OpenStax Chemistry 2e — hybridization exercise on allene
supports: Allene is a standard case in which carbon hybridisation and perpendicular terminal planes are reasoned together.
does_not_support: Any unique quantitative electronic-structure interpretation beyond the introductory orbital model.

benchmark_given_policy.rule: Facts explicitly supplied in Q1-Q10 remain benchmark givens. Source cards support the teaching/model boundaries and advanced background; they do not relabel supplied observations as measurements made by this run.
examples: Q1 supplied approximately planar amide arrangement and permitted lone-pair donation.
